H1.rule: GEE longitudinal drift slope b1 significant after Benjamini-Hochberg FDR (requires >= 4 study weeks).

H2.rule: Change points detected via PELT/CUSUM with cluster bootstrap CI excluding 0 (requires >= 4 study weeks).

H3.rule: Two One-Sided Tests (TOST) on local control model within +/-0.03 margin (requires >= 4 study weeks).

H4.rule: GEE week:language interaction terms b3 for Telugu/Tenglish (requires >= 4 study weeks).

H5.rule: Proportion of supported change points matching public provider release notes (requires >= 4 study weeks).

H6.rule: Paired difference in ASR between native (v2) and machine (v1) scenarios with CI excluding 0.
